summary: First-finish testing of JanNyaya. Backend all 6 tested endpoints pass (root, create/list/get/delete chat, SSE streaming, upload PDF success + DOCX 400 reject, search filter). Frontend main flow passes: empty state with 4 suggested prompt cards, click creates chat and routes to /c/{id}, typing indicator appears, SSE streams, markdown renders as HTML (h1 tags present, no raw markdown chars), New Chat resets to home, send button disabled when empty, 0 console errors. One concern: sidebar chat list did not display the created chat via data-testid='chat-list-item' selector.
passed: POST /api/chats creates chat with id and session_id
GET /api/chats?session_id=X lists chats; ?q=IPC filters correctly (1 match), ?q=nomatch returns 0
GET /api/chats/{id} returns full chat; unknown id returns 404
DELETE /api/chats/{id} removes chat (deleted:1) and list becomes empty
POST /api/message/stream streams SSE 'data: {t: ...}' chunks, ends with 'event: done'; persists user+assistant messages; auto-sets title from first user message ('Define IPC 302 in one sentence')
POST /api/upload PDF returns extracted_text; DOCX rejected with 400
Frontend loads with 'How can JanNyaya assist you today?' and 4 suggested-prompt-card elements
Clicking suggested prompt: URL becomes /c/{uuid}, typing-indicator appears, stream completes, response rendered as HTML markdown (h1) not raw markdown
new-chat-button navigates back to '/' with empty state
send-message-button is disabled when composer is empty
No console errors during full chat flow

failed.issue: After successfully creating a chat (URL is /c/{id}, backend confirms chat exists), sidebar query for data-testid='chat-list-item' returns 0 items. Sidebar UI shows 'No conversations yet. Start a new chat to begin.' The search filter test and delete-chat test could therefore not be exercised through the UI. Backend search /api/chats?q= itself works.
failed.evidence: TEST-6 sidebar chat items: 0 (right after streaming completed and while URL=/c/a50509d4-...); backend list returned 1 chat. Screenshot shows sidebar 'No conversations yet.'

action_items: Verify Sidebar.js refreshes chat list after new chat creation / after streaming completes (call refresh in ChatPage after createChat or after stream end). Alternatively confirm data-testid='chat-list-item' is applied on each rendered chat row.
Once sidebar refresh is fixed, retest search filter via UI and hover-delete flow.
